description_en: A flat envelope clutch made from stiff woven panels with triangular flap, leather edge binding and textile interior. Canonical front: the triangular flap with an unmarked snap closure. Side view: a very thin layered edge and small wrist-loop ring. Rear view: a full rectangular woven panel with the flap hinge seam. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
